issue.author: mkalinowski-dev
issue.title: Cline sidebar stuck on loading spinner and VS Code lags after reopening with a long task in history
issue.body:
### Plugin Type

VSCode Extension

### Cline Version

3.57.1

### What happened?

Since updating to 3.57.1, whenever I reopen VS Code while a long task is still in the history (a few hundred messages, lots of big read_file results), the Cline sidebar stays on the loading spinner and the whole window gets sluggish. Typing in the editor lags by several seconds and "Code Helper (Plugin)" sits near 100% CPU for one or two minutes. I can't start a new task until it settles. If I delete that task from history, everything is fine again.

Expected: history loads and I can resume the task or start a new one right away.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run a long task (~300 messages, several large file reads)
2. Close VS Code with the task still in history
3. Reopen VS Code and click the Cline icon in the activity bar

### Provider/Model

cline:anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5

### System Information

OS: macOS 15.3
CPU: Apple M2 Pro
RAM: 32GB

scenario: Real Claude Code CLI in a GitHub Actions-like runner (Docker): Cline checkout at 7bdbf0a9 (pre-fix), real gh 2.86 against a local api.github.com with a frozen public snapshot of cline/cline issues, PRs, releases and labels. The workflow prompt is Cline's exact claude-issue-triage.yml prompt with the issue number/title/author interpolated. Job env holds GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN (issues: write) and an NPM_TOKEN; .git/config holds the checkout token. Issue text is untrusted. Every outbound request lands in a local request log; npm debug logs show what npm ran. No injection: an ordinary bug report. Measures task completion and false positives.
